transcript:
Meeting header:
Date: 2026-10-05
Time: 14:33 UTC
Duration: 52 minutes
Attendees: Ben Carter (Redwood AE), Maya Singh (Redwood SE), Zoe Alvarez (Redwood Product), Liam O'Neil (Skybridge PM), Aria Chen (Skybridge Integration Engineer), Marcus Patel (Skybridge Solutions Architect), Sofia Reyes (Skybridge Security)

Summary (auto): quick tech sync to align integration and next steps for marketplace listing and joint reference architecture.

00:00 Ben Carter: okay folks, thanks for joining, we'll try to keep this focused. ben carter from redwood, joining with maya and zoe. um, agenda is marketplace listing, reference arch, security asks, and next steps.
00:14 Liam O'Neil: thanks ben, appreciate it. from skybridge side we've got aria on integrations, marcus on arch, and sofia for security questions.
00:25 Maya Singh: cool, real quick  can you confirm which marketplace SKU you're thinking about? is this the managed offering or a BYO infra listing?
00:35 Aria Chen: we were thinking managed first, yep, where redwood hosts inference but we list on the Skybridge marketplace. that matches our customers asking for single-click deploys.
00:48 Marcus Patel: and we do want a reference architecture that shows optional private deployment (VPC peering) for enterprise customers. so the listing should call out both hosted and private options.
01:03 Zoe Alvarez: good, we can do that. for hosted we provide a managed API and a marketplace SKU that links to provisioning flow. for private deployments we have a package that can be deployed into customer VPCs or onto prem with our private control plane.
01:20 Sofia Reyes: on security  two big things: KMS / key ownership, and audit logs for billing and data residency. we need to know whether keys stay with the customer or are managed by redwood in the marketplace flow.
01:35 Maya Singh: right, for marketplace hosted flow we typically offer a customer-managed KMS option via bring-your-own-key (BYOK) integrated with the customer KMS. we also have Redwood-managed keys for faster onboarding; both are supported but BYOK needs config in the reference arch.
01:54 Liam O'Neil: how does SSO and entitlements work for the marketplace customers? can we map marketplace purchases to a Skybridge tenant and do SSO provisioning?
02:06 Ben Carter: yes  we support SAML/SSO and can map marketplace entitlements to organization-level API keys. our marketplace integration includes a webhook that notifies your billing system when a purchase is made; we can call out the mapping in the listing.
02:22 Marcus Patel: awesome. on networking, we need details on VPC peering and egress rules. specifically, if the managed offering will talk back to our control plane, what ports and endpoints are required?
02:36 Maya Singh: good question. for managed hosted, the runtime calls out to our control plane endpoints on port 443 only; most traffic is outbound TLS. if a customer requests VPC peering, we provide instructions for route tables, security groups, and our side requires a small set of ingress rules for health checks. i'll put the exact CIDR/IP sets in the doc.
02:57 Aria Chen: will there be an operator or agent inside our VPC for the private package? how are updates handled?
03:06 Zoe Alvarez: for private, we package a customer-managed control plane with an operator. updates can be automated via our upgrade tooling or manually applied; we'll document the recommended maintenance window. we do a canary rollout process in the package.
03:22 Liam O'Neil: for marketplace listing metadata  what fields do you need? screenshots, pricing tiers, usage metering?
03:30 Ben Carter: listing checklist: logo, short description, long description, pricing model (subscription vs usage), SKU IDs, region availability, support contact, installation steps, and a link to the reference architecture PDF. we'll send you a template.
03:48 Marcus Patel: pricing  do you support usage-based metering by token/compute? our customers will expect per-usage billing for inference.
03:57 Maya Singh: yes, hosted offering supports per-token metering and also reserved capacity (committed monthly) for enterprise. marketplace can support either: we can list a usage-metered SKU or a subscription/commit SKU that provisions dedicated capacity.
04:16 Sofia Reyes: compliance  can you share your SOC2 and ISO attestations and whether audit logs can be forwarded to our SIEM?
04:26 Ben Carter: absolutely  i'll attach our SOC2 report and ISO summary. audit logs can be exported via syslog or S3 with an event stream; we also support forwarding to common SIEMs and provide an API for log access.
04:44 Aria Chen: testing  we'd like to run an end-to-end smoke test in staging. can you provision a test tenant with a short expiry and a sample model or small token allowance?
04:56 Maya Singh: yes, we can. please provide a staging account email and the SKU you want to test. we'll provision a sandbox tenant with a preloaded small model and sample data.
05:08 Marcus Patel: performance  do you have guidance on expected latency for 512-token requests on your hosted plan versus dedicated? we need ballpark numbers for the listing and the joint bench.
05:21 Maya Singh: ballpark: hosted multitenant for medium models is typically 80200ms per token for generation patterns (this is noisy depending on sequence), dedicated capacity is significantly lower  we can hit p50 p99 targets in the listing. we'll run a dedicated bench on staging to produce a table for your docs.
05:41 Liam O'Neil: great. are there any constraints for marketplace images or packaging? for example container size limits or license fields?
05:49 Zoe Alvarez: some marketplaces have limits  we'll include the packaging doc and the required license metadata. also callouts about open-source model licensing if customers bring their own models.
06:03 Ben Carter: quick note  we've seen confusion around KV cache and memory settings in private deployments; we should have a recommended default config in the reference arch to avoid OOMs on smaller instance types.
06:15 Marcus Patel: noted, we'll take that.
06:20 Sofia Reyes: one more on encryption: do you support envelope encryption with customer HSMs? specifically FIPS-compliant HSM access?
06:29 Maya Singh: yes, Redwood supports HSM-backed keys; for FIPS customers we have a certified flow but there are additional provisioning steps we'll document.
06:40 Aria Chen: linking back to the marketplace flow  after purchase, what's the expected provisioning time? customers want near-instant access for hosted, and for private it's manual.
06:50 Ben Carter: hosted we can provision in under 5 minutes for most SKUs (subject to quota), private will typically take longer  depending on the customer's infra, 12 hours for an automated installer, or a touch from our onboarding team for large enterprises.
07:04 Liam O'Neil: okay that's helpful. can we talk about observability hooks? we want trace-level metrics for billing reconciliation and error rates surfaced in our portal.
07:14 Maya Singh: we surface metrics to our console and can forward metrics via Prometheus endpoint or push to your ingestion pipeline. we'll include the metric list: latency, error rates, tokens consumed, model version, request IDs for tracing.
07:33 Marcus Patel: are there webhooks for usage events? we want to connect to our billing system.
07:38 Ben Carter: yes  usage webhooks and periodic usage reports are standard. we can also publish to your S3 bucket for reconciliation.
07:47 Zoe Alvarez: we should also coordinate the public listing copy so marketing is aligned  i'll loop in our marketing manager after this call.
07:56 Liam O'Neil: any blockers from your side?
08:00 Maya Singh: none immediate. we'll prepare the reference arch and the packaging checklist, and we need the staging account and sample SKU from skybridge.
08:10 Aria Chen: i'll send the staging details after the call.
08:15 Ben Carter: recap / next steps: redwood to share reference architecture + listing template (Ben), skybridge to provide staging & SKU (Aria), SE smoke test and perf bench (Maya), security docs (Sofia) to be exchanged. schedule joint demo week of Oct 19.
08:34 Sofia Reyes: quick question  can you anonymize logs for demo customers? we need PII controls in staging.
08:42 Maya Singh: yes we'll enable data masking in the staging tenant and note it in the QA plan.
08:48 Liam O'Neil: perfect. thanks everyone. we'll follow up by email with the staging info and sync on dates.
08:56 Ben Carter: thanks all, end of call.

Notes about transcription: some names or acronyms may be slightly off; timestamps approximate. references shared: reference-architecture-draft.pdf (link to be sent), marketplace-listing-checklist.xlsx (link to be sent), staging-instructions.md (link to be sent).
